sentence: This project builds methods that let machine learning models give a small set of possible answers, with the correct answer guaranteed to be included.
This project provides open access to tools for nanotechnology research and studies how nanotechnology affects society.
This project studies how certain rocks react with water to produce hydrogen and how to sustain that hydrogen production over time.
This project develops computational methods to reconstruct full-length mRNAs from the two alleles of a gene using RNA sequencing data.
This project builds forensic tools to analyze shared machine learning model files, detect data injection, and link models to their training systems.
This project builds and tests a computer-based learning partner that helps elementary students reflect on their thinking as they solve fraction problems.
This project studies how well tree seedlings survive and grow across different environments, and whether they adapt to changing conditions.
This project builds aerial robots that use lightweight cables to form hitches so they can grasp and transport objects without human intervention.
This project studies how microbes and animals return to deep-sea vents after a volcanic eruption and how the ecosystem recovers.
This project studies how interactions among molecules within cells, between males and females, and across species affect how populations evolve.
This project builds smaller, softer probes that produce light with narrow spectra to record fluorescence from neurons in deep brain regions.
This project builds deep learning methods that treat wireless data as curves to make wireless network measurements more accurate and robust.
This project improves the graph-based search methods in vector databases so they are faster, more reliable, and need fewer computational resources.
This project develops conductive wool yarn that is knitted into circuit components for wearable electronic devices.
This project uses deep learning to create safety certificates that help show robots with learning-based controllers operate safely.
This project upgrades software that analyzes DNA and protein sequences so it can handle very large datasets using less memory and processing.
This project builds faster machine learning methods that work when the usual calculations are too costly or the needed information is unavailable.
This project builds a cybersecurity curriculum that includes artificial intelligence.
This project develops low-cost wireless sensor networks where many devices sense together to detect events and make decisions accurately.
This project expands free open-source software, hardware and data for teaching energy systems to more fields such as manufacturing and environmental science.
